- [What a Dubai service charge actually pays for](http://localhost/realtorraihan/service-charge/): Two buildings on the same street can carry charges that differ by 40%. Here is what sits inside that number, and how to read the statement before you sign.
- [Gross yield is a sales number. Net yield is the real one](http://localhost/realtorraihan/gross-vs-net-yield/): The gap between the two is service charge, management, vacancy and chiller. On a Business Bay studio that spread is wider than most buyers expect.
- [Off-plan payment plans, read line by line](http://localhost/realtorraihan/off-plan-payment-plans/): A 60/40 and an 80/20 plan are not the same deal. What the post-handover percentage really costs you, and the clauses worth negotiating.
- [Pricing a listing so it sells, not so it sits](http://localhost/realtorraihan/pricing-a-listing/): Overpricing costs more than a lower asking price. How I set a number from comparable transactions rather than from hope.
- [Choosing a community before you choose a building](http://localhost/realtorraihan/choosing-a-community/): You can renovate an apartment, you cannot move the school run. The five questions I ask before we look at a single listing.
- [Golden Visa through property: what qualifies](http://localhost/realtorraihan/golden-visa/): Property is one of the routes to a UAE Golden Visa, and it is the one most buyers ask about. The headline is simple; the conditions are where people get stuck.
